title: Only 7% Pass This Cambridge Entrance Exam
summary: Patterns, scientific evidence, data and hidden mechanisms test how tightly you can control every variable.

landing.intro: Experiments, patterns and data collide. Can you spot the hidden variable before the evidence turns against you?

about.body:
This worldwide entertainment challenge contains ten Cambridge-inspired questions across numerical patterns, experiments, scientific reasoning, data interpretation and spatial thinking. The final items combine rules rather than rewarding obscure knowledge.

Choose the answer that follows from the information shown. No specialist university knowledge is required, and correctness remains hidden until the final reveal.

This is not an official University of Cambridge admissions test, application assessment or prediction of admission.

howToPlay.title: How to Play
steps: Complete ten carefully selected questions in one focused challenge.
Choose one answer each time. Correctness remains hidden until the final reveal.
Reveal your result, skill breakdown and complete answer review after the final question.

about.disclaimer: Independent entertainment challenge. Not an official Cambridge admissions test and not affiliated with any university.

stage-1.preAdCopy: Your Cambridge entrance score and three-area breakdown are ready to reveal.

profile-1.title: The Systems Standout
profile-1.copy: You moved confidently between patterns, mechanisms and evidence while keeping the important variables separate.

profile-2.title: The Cambridge Natural
profile-2.copy: You crossed the challenge line with strong quantitative and scientific reasoning.

profile-3.title: The Supervision Specialist
profile-3.copy: You solved most systems accurately and adapted well when the problem changed form.

profile-4.title: The Methodical Thinker
profile-4.copy: You built sound solutions across several technical styles and have a clear base to refine.

profile-5.title: The Promising Applicant
profile-5.copy: Many core patterns clicked, while the review identifies the variables worth checking twice.

profile-6.title: The Curious Investigator
profile-6.copy: Some systems resisted this attempt, but every result gives you another clue about how the rule works.

score.passed: You passed the Cambridge entrance challenge!

cambridge-s1q6.question: Two identical plants receive different fertilisers. What should be kept the same for a fair test?

cambridge-s2q8.question: Which variable is measured as the outcome of an experiment?

cambridge-s2q7.question: A beaker reading rises from 40 mL to 55 mL after an object is submerged. What volume is displaced?

cambridge-s3q3.question: Starting at 3, repeat this full rule to get each next term: add 2, then multiply by 2. Which sequence is correct?

cambridge-s3q8.question: A claim predicts X. The experiment observes not-X under valid conditions. What is the best response?

cambridge-s4q7.question: Which description shows reflection rather than rotation?
answers: A left-facing shape flipped to face right across a vertical line

cambridge-s5q8.question: A model predicts 12, 18 and 24 for three trials. Actual values are 13, 17 and 24. What is the total absolute error?

cambridge-s5q5.question: A marker moves north 2, east 3, then south 2. Where is it relative to the start?

cambridge-s5q7.question: A sensor shows 26 after a +2 calibration offset. The true value then falls by 5. What will the sensor show next?
